tasks.detail: Same time daily. 9 hours in bed the night before is the target.
Sensodyne (potassium nitrate + fluoride), soft brush, 2 min. Floss. Rinse thoroughly.
Water rinse (gentle cleanser if oily) -> moisturizer -> SPF 30+ on face, ears, neck. Two fingers' length.
Every day, not just sunny ones.
Heels, glutes, upper back, head all in contact. This is the reference posture.
After the shower, never before. Shave cream not canned foam. Zero pressure, short strokes, with the grain first. Cold rinse, pat dry, moisturize.
40P / 35F / 110C. Eat it even when not hungry; the surplus is the whole plan.
Only during the 20-treatment block. Needs 35+ min since brushing; pat teeth dry first; upper strip then lower, tooth surface only.
Rinse with water. Do NOT brush for 60 min after.
15P / 20F / 50C. Nuts, whole milk, fruit - dense and fast.
Every doorway you walk through today: chest open, shoulders back and down, hands out of pockets.
Arms swinging from the shoulder, torso allowed to rotate, feet tracking slightly apart. Amplitude, not tempo.
10 min - footwork ladder, handling drops, mobility. Never dive cold.
20 min - set position, W-catch, collapse dive mechanics. Quality over volume.
25 min - Handling & high balls. Game-speed reps.
5 min - hip/shoulder mobility, wrists and fingers.
Zone 2, conversational pace. You should be able to talk through it. Not intervals.
Watch the chest and back.
40P / 25F / 85C. Inside 90 min of finishing.
20P / 30F / 150C. Check fiber for the day - 40g is the floor.
4,005 kcal | 150P / 145F / 525C / 40g fiber. Under by 300+? Add a shake before bed.
Last meal done, last strip long gone.
Skip the mouthwash if you whitened today.
Gentle cleanser -> moisturizer. That is the whole routine.
